posts.body: anyone booked or thinking about booking there summer holiday yet?

We haven't booked anything yet but we'd love to go somewhere nice together. We will have been together for one year this summer (!) so it would be really good to do something for that. We both work at the same company so we have to coordinate our time off, bet our bosses love it when we both go away, lol!
We're also hoping to move house before the Summer so things could get a little hectic!
We still haven't had a holiday together 🙁 can't afford to.
